title: Customer's Success Story | WoodBull & Customily
summary: WoodBull grew revenue 43% after adding real-time personalization. See how they turned gifts into unforgettable experiences.
body_markdown:
Some brands begin with a product,[WoodBull](https://woodbull.com.br/) began with a feeling.


Created with the mission of turning moments into memories, WoodBull set out to design meaningful gifts crafted with care, warmth, and intention. From the very beginning, customers gravitated not only toward the quality of the products but toward something deeper: the emotion behind each piece. A gift made *especially* for someone.


**That personal touch quickly became more than a feature, it became the identity of the brand.**


“From the start, personalization was at the heart of our purpose. We always knew we wanted to create gifts that carried real meaning.”


As the brand evolved and customer expectations grew, one thing became clear: **people wanted to see their creations come to life. They wanted not just a product, but an experience, one that felt interactive, emotional, and uniquely theirs.**


That’s when WoodBull discovered[Customily](https://www.customily.com/) .


## **A Personalization Experience That Feels Like Magic**


The moment WoodBull tested Customily, **the team knew they had found the perfect partner.** The platform delivered exactly what they had been looking for: **an intuitive, visual,**[engaging personalizer](https://www.customily.com/our-features) **that made the shopping experience smoother, faster, and far more emotional.**


“Customily offered a delightful personalization experience that made every purchase more engaging and trustworthy.”


With Customily, WoodBull redesigned its entire customer journey. Shoppers were now able to **personalize in real time, preview their creations instantly, and feel connected to the creative process** , all before checking out. The effects were immediate.


- Faster customer support
- Higher conversion rates
- A more interactive and memorable buying experience


**For WoodBull, this wasn’t just a feature upgrade, it was a transformation.**


## **A Breakthrough Product: Personalized Barbecue Kits**


WoodBull’s first Customily-powered release was a series of personalized barbecue kits. What happened next exceeded every expectation.


**The kits became an instant bestseller.**


Customers fell in love with how easy it was to customize them, adding names, messages, and symbols that made each set feel exclusive and heartfelt. This launch didn’t just perform well, it marked the beginning of a new era for the brand.


“The success of our barbecue kits marked the beginning of a more technological, emotional, and scalable WoodBull.”


## **Tools That Deepen the Emotional Connection**


While WoodBull uses many of[Customily’s features](https://www.customily.com/our-features) , a few stand out as game-changers:


- **Real-time preview:** customers immediately see their personalized product
- **Photo uploads:** gifts become more meaningful and visual
- **Custom text:** messages, names, and dedications add emotional value


These tools created an instant bond between customer and product. Instead of imagining how a gift might look, shoppers now saw it exactly as it would be delivered, creating excitement and confidence with every change.


## **A 43% Revenue Boost After Adding Customily**


The numbers speak for themselves.


**After integrating Customily, WoodBull saw monthly revenue increase by over 43% compared to the previous period.** Visual personalization didn’t just improve the shopping experience, it amplified the emotional connection customers felt with the brand.


This is the perfect example of how technology, when used with intention, deepens human connection rather than replacing it.


## **What Makes WoodBull Successful**


At its core, WoodBull is driven by purpose and care. Every product is crafted to touch hearts. Every detail matters. Every gift is designed to be meaningful, exclusive, and unforgettable.


“We believe our success comes from the combination of technology, purpose, and care in every detail.”


This commitment is what turns customers into loyal fans and gifts into memories that last.


## **Looking Ahead: Expanding the World of Personalization**


WoodBull’s biggest challenge for the next few years is also its biggest opportunity: scaling personalization even further.


The brand plans to deepen its use of Customily and expand its catalog with gifts that are even more customizable, emotional, and unique, always staying true to its essence: **turning feelings into unforgettable gifts.**


## **Advice for New Entrepreneurs**


WoodBull’s message to new business owners is simple but powerful: “Start with purpose and authenticity. Brands that truly connect with people will always find their space.”


In a fast-paced digital market, experience, trust, and meaningful details make all the difference.
